author: Corridor Crew
description: Guillermo del Toro's Frankenstein took a very successful approach to its VFX. Instead of relying heavily on CGI, as many other big-budget modern movies do, they built many of the creatures and elements practically, using CGI only where needed to sell the illusion. Props to VFX studio MR.X for their work on this scene.
title: This creature is REAL?!
